name: scout-ascci
description: Monorepo SCOUT ASCCI : API (NestJS) commune, frontend paroissial et application district (Next.js), chaque plateforme sur sa propre installation.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @scout/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,paroisse,district -c gray,blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @scout/shared" "npm run dev -w @scout/api" "npm run dev -w @scout/web-paroisse" "npm run dev -w @scout/web-district"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scout/shared && npm run build -w @scout/api -w @scout/web-paroisse -w @scout/web-district
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @scout/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @scout/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
